With a tranquil smile and melodious voice, she shares profound insights and teaches techniques for overcoming affliction. None are turned away from Guanyin’s care. Be they flesh or machine, mortal or transcendent, she perceives their True Heart and knows the pathway to peace. In her presence, one feels the weight of aeons lift and gains a glimpse of enlightenment. Her influence ripples outward to touch unnumbered lives with renewal and hope. The Bodhisattva has come again in disguise, and in her infinite mercy brings solace to all realms.
